info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Workforce Contracts Management API
info.description: The Workforce Contracts Management API facilitates the creation and management of workforce contracts within the banking sector. This API allows businesses to dynamically create new contracts that define employment terms and conditions for human resources. Typical consumers include HR managers and financial administrators who require streamlined processes for contract generation and modification. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance efficiency in workforce management and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new workforce contract within the human resource management system. You need to provide the necessary details in the request body to successfully create a contract for the workforce.
